title: Bastille, no
logline: A tourist's flag on the seawall — not ours — and the page not asking whose, drawing it as a color the town doesn't have. The pup under the bench. A man in plaid from behind. The page's one joke about the calendar, unmade.

panels.composition: A seawall in July with a tourist holding a small foreign flag on a stick, drawn in a color the page otherwise lacks, a man in plaid from behind on the bench, a small three-legged dog beneath it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall in July with a tourist holding a small flag on a stick in a color the page otherwise lacks, a man in plaid flannel seen from behind on a bench and a small three-legged dog beneath it, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
